FROM orders
WHERE order_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month

    strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month,
    SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) AS sales_amount

JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id

ORDER BY month

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) = '2026-10' THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) -
     SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) = '2026-09' THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END)) AS sales_change
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.name = '数码' THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) as digital_sales,
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) as total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped');

SELECT 
    c.name,
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) as sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.name;

    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) as total_sales

SELECT 
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT 
    c.name as category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) as gross_profit
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1
